topic: Mastering the Product and Chain Rules in Calculus

sections.title: Prerequisite Warm-up: The Concept of Rate
lecture_lines: Derivatives measure instantaneous change as a rate.
Think of functions as input-output machines.
Complex functions nest or multiply smaller ones.
animations: Create an animation showing a function as a machine taking 'x' as input to produce 'f(x)' output, color: #FFFFFF.
Demonstrate the concept of instantaneous change as a tangent line slope on a curve, color: #00FF00.
Animate two functions nesting or multiplying to show their interaction, color: #FF00FF.

sections.title: The Product Rule: The Collaborative Duo
lecture_lines: Multiplying functions creates a growing area.
Area change requires both sides changing.
The Product Rule sums these two effects.
animations: Visualise a rectangle with sides u(x) and v(x) growing, color: #FFFF00.
Animate the change in area by expanding width and height independently, color: #00FFFF.
Display the formula u'(x)v(x) + u(x)v'(x) with color coding for each term, color: #FFFFFF.

sections.title: The Chain Rule: The Nested Gears
lecture_lines: Nested functions act like rotating gears.
Turning one gear moves the next one.
Multiply gear ratios for total speed.
animations: Create two connected gears representing nested functions f(g(x)), color: #FFA500.
Show the first gear turning and causing the second gear to move proportionally, color: #FF4500.
Label the gear ratios as f'(g(x)) and g'(x) and highlight their product, color: #FFFFFF.

sections.title: Interactive Synthesis: Putting it Together
lecture_lines: Analyze complex functions from outside in.
Peel layers with the Chain Rule.
Identify internal products for the Product Rule.
animations: Animate a complex function composed of nested layers, color: #00BFFF.
Show the process of 'peeling' away the outer layer with the Chain Rule, color: #FF1493.
Identify and highlight product sub-structures to apply the Product Rule, color: #32CD32.

sections.title: Conclusion & Summary
lecture_lines: Product Rule: Derivative of u times v.
Chain Rule: Outer derivative times inner derivative.
Master these rules to model change.
animations: Place the formula (uv)' = u'v + uv' in a central box, color: #FFFF00.
Place the formula (f(g))' = f'(g)g' below it in a central box, color: #FF4500.
Show a final summary graphic with both formulas and a checkmark, color: #FFFFFF.
